announcement: Every piece is made by hand, to order. Worldwide enquiries welcome — message us to order.

faq.q: Can I buy directly from the website?
faq.a: Not at the moment. We deliberately don't run an online checkout: every piece is handmade, so we like to talk with you first about the design, colours and details. Send us an enquiry and we'll take care of the rest personally.
Yes. We love creating for people all over the world. Tell us your country in your enquiry and we'll discuss delivery options, timing and costs with you before anything is confirmed.

faq.q: Can I commission a custom design?
faq.a: Absolutely. Custom art orders are one of the things we love most. Share your colours, ideas or inspiration and we'll propose a design for your approval. Every custom bag is painted and knotted just for you.

faq.q: Will my bag look exactly like the photos?
faq.a: Each piece is painted or knotted by hand, so small variations are what make it one of a kind. Your bag will carry the same spirit, palette and quality as the photos, but it will be uniquely yours.

faq.q: How do I look after my bag?
faq.a: Spot-clean painted pieces gently with a damp cloth and avoid soaking them. Knotted pieces can be reshaped by hand and aired out; avoid harsh detergents. We'll share full care notes with every order.

faq.q: How do I pay, and how long will it take?
faq.a: Payment method and timeline are agreed with you directly once the design is confirmed, so you always know exactly what to expect before we begin.
